Canvas Downloader installed NVIDIA's CUDA libraries (cuBLAS + cuDNN) (cuda 12.9.79, cublas 12.9.2.10, cudnn 9.25.0.15) so transcription can run on your GPU instead of the CPU. Remove them below to reclaim about 1.3 GB - transcription keeps working, just on the CPU.

Remove CUDA libraries
